**Finding: TRANSITION — missing (redline proposed, preferred level)**

The Agreement has no exit or data-return mechanic. Article XXI ("Effect of Termination") is entirely one-directional: our licences terminate automatically, we must ship all Licensed Technology, Documentation and Confidential Information to Licensor within five days with an officer's certification, and "All of the Licensor's rights under this Agreement shall survive termination." Nothing obliges Licensor to return or export our data or to help us migrate. Article XX permits automatic/immediate termination on a change of control or wind-up, and Article X's confidentiality regime again covers only Licensor's material — so we could lose access with no copy of our data, which is walk-away territory under the rule.

Cure: a single inserted paragraph after Article XXI carrying only the six preferred elements — up to six months' transition assistance at Licensor's then-current rates on expiry or termination, return of Licensee Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and written certification of deletion *after* that return. Licensee Data is defined inline since the Agreement has no customer-data definition. The 90-day assistance / 30-day export fallback remains available in negotiation.
